title: tc interp had no sandbox cwd, so std/fs file syscalls always failed
root_cause: run_interp called tc_ir::interpret (cwd=None) instead of interpret_in_dir, disabling sandboxed openat/read/write/close/lseek.
fix: Added --cwd <dir> to tc interp and routed it through interpret_in_dir.

title: Assignment verbs rejected auto-phrase values
repro: Set result to last item of address of values.
root_cause: The assignment-verb lowering parsed candidate values with parse_expr instead of phrase-aware parse_value.
fix: Route Set/Put assignment values through parse_value so auto phrases and explicit phrases are accepted.

title: Indented control blocks inside paragraph functions were flattened and dropped
repro:
To pick given a as a whole number, b as a whole number... If a is less than b:
    Give back a.
Give back b.
root_cause: normalize_natural_source clamped body indentation to the function base instead of preserving relative nesting.
fix: Add the original relative indent to the paragraph/control base indent.

title: IntMap and StrMap hung or corrupted after 256 entries
repro: Insert 300 keys into IntMap of whole number.
root_cause: std/map.eng allocated a fixed 256-slot table and never rehashed or grew; full IntMap probing looped forever.
fix: Added std/map.eng rehash int map and grow text map helpers, growth checks in put, and 300/260-key regressions.
